annotations.title: The last 7 days on Australian Bitcoin exchanges

description: How Australian Bitcoin exchanges compared over the last 7 days (or since checks began, if that is shorter), for A$1,000 through each one's cheapest AUD route. Returns each ranked Live exchange's average all-in cost (deposit fee, trading fee and spread, averaged over every 5-minute check), the cheapest and dearest on average and the gap between them in dollars, how often each exchange was #1 and how many times #1 changed hands, and how the BTC/AUD reference price moved. Use get_sats_per_dollar for the ranking right now. General information, not financial advice.
